column4: Bypass package + doWipePersistProvisionedData from Fleet: reset in 13 min, fleetd reinstalled itself and the host came back as the same Fleet host 25 at the region screen with no prompt, MDM re-enrolled (mdm_enrolled 00:39:05), lab1 and its data gone, package kept.
Lab fault: the reset ran with only virtio-gpu, which the reset environment cannot draw on; it sat idle for 10 min, and a power cycle mid-reset left Windows unbootable. Rerun as C-2r.

No-bypass package + doWipePersistProvisionedData: host came back as the same Fleet host 27 in 13 min with no IdP sign-in and MDM re-enrolled; Fleet keeps the previous end user eua-user-1 attributed (repurposing gap).

Delete the host after the wipe acknowledges, and the reset host must authenticate again: Fleet blocks enrollment, fleetd opens the sign-in page at the new user desktop (not on the setup screen), and after eua-user-2 signs in Fleet shows a new host with only eua-user-2. Second reset of the host (X-1) also worked.

Brownfield path works: a Fleet script staged the package in C:\Recovery\Customizations on an MSI-enrolled host, and after doWipePersistProvisionedData the host came back as the same Fleet host in 12.5 min with MDM on and no prompt.

Cloud variant works: doWipeCloudPersistProvisionedData downloaded an image for about 36 min, reset, and the same Fleet host came back with MDM on and no prompt, 57 min in total. Its command result can no longer be read once the host re-enrolls (Fleet bug, all wipe commands).
